---
title: "A document that defines its own window function"
filters:
  - code-window
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

The document defines the window function itself, so the filter keeps it.
The first block and the `inline code` come before that definition.

```{.python filename="before.py"}
w = 0
```

```{=typst}
#let code-window(content, ..args) = content
```

```{.python filename="x.py"}
x = 1
```
